subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind syntax should OpenClaw support for conversation peer routing without breaking the existing <channel>:<account> CLI contract?
rationale: The bug is real, but the permanent grammar affects persisted config, account routing, docs, and several competing open PRs, so automation should not choose the product contract by implication.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
options.body: Keep <channel>:<account> as accountId and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned resolver that does not reinterpret existing account binds.

options.title: Use Feishu ID detection
options.body: Treat known Feishu conversation ID shapes as peers while preserving unknown values as account IDs, with tests for account, group, direct, and topic IDs.

options.title: Pause this branch for a sibling candidate
options.body: Close or pause this mixed branch and adopt a narrower candidate after maintainers pick the syntax and proof path.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer syntax
recommendation.body: Keep <channel>:<account> as accountId and add a documented peer/conversation form or plugin-owned resolver that does not reinterpret existing account binds.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent routing and agents CLI docs work makes this the best available owner for the compatibility and public-syntax decision.
